# Persis Leigh

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P7](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0007), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P14](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0014), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P43](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0043)</sub>

- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [John Selwyn](../character/john-selwyn.md) (spouse)

## Appearance

Persis Leigh possesses big, clear, hazel eyes and an English skin. She is also distinguished by her heaps of glossy brown hair.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P45](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0045)_

## Personality

Persis Leigh is described as a sweet and winsome individual who naturally draws affection from others. She also possesses a high-spirited nature that can lead to quarrels.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P45](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0045), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P48](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0048)_

## History

Persis Leigh was raised by her uncle, remaining to care for him when he fell ill out of loyalty for how he had looked after her following her parents' deaths.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P7](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0007)_

## Relationships

### [John Selwyn](../character/john-selwyn.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/john-selwyn--persis-leigh.md)

Persis Leigh is romantically involved with [John Selwyn](../character/john-selwyn.md) as his sweetheart and fiancé, having traveled out with the intention of marrying him. By Volume 4, their relationship has progressed to marriage, making them husband and wife.
